headline: It will be one of the largest mines of its kind. Cost: nearly $2 billion
summary: Rio Tinto has begun construction of the Kangwinan bauxite mine in Australia. The facility is set to add 20 million tonnes of annual output from 2029, with investment of almost $2 billion.
why: Rio Tinto is a global mining group headquartered in London and Melbourne, and a major producer of bauxite, aluminium, iron ore and copper. Bauxite is the raw material for aluminium, so new supply affects aluminium markets.

impacts.name: Rio Tinto
impacts.why: The company is investing almost $2 billion to build a bauxite mine that adds 20 million tonnes of annual output.
